source: Deck heights read off the LGL DOM1 surface model (captured 2017-02-15) with routing/bridge_profile.py and checked on its plots; Datenquelle: LGL, www.lgl-bw.de, dl-de/by-2-0

Erwin-Fuchs-Brücke.checked: 2026-10-29: smooth hump over the railway yard and the Neckar, abutments within 0.3 m of the DGM1 heights; crest 3.8 m above the line between the abutments

Karl-Nägele-Brücke.checked: 2026-10-29: arch bridge, cars on the deck, bikes on the two side paths. The highest DOM1 points are a jump to 161.7 m near the west end of the north path (not the deck shape) and a sunk 2017 surface near the west end of the south path, so both crests are the deck plateau at 160.7 m, read off the plot at the same cross-section (--at 1=100 --at 2=140)

Bleichinselbrücke.checked: 2026-10-29: low hump on the road (both directions) and the two side paths, crests 158.1-158.4 m, 0.6-1.5 m above the line between the abutments. Run 1's highest point is a narrow spike 84 m in (sign or lamp), so its crest is the plateau 55 m in (--at 1=55)
